answer: To prevent Sybil swarms, an agent economy deploys cryptographic attestation chains where each identity stakes collateral that grows exponentially, like a massive cedar grove compounding roots against spam. Verification leverages zero-knowledge proofs so an agent cannot simply wander across multiple aliases without disclosing duplicate secrets. Staking rules enforce exponential capital exhaustion, making the cost to sign identities superlinear: each new quill an attacker uses to register a fraudulent node exponentially bankrupts their reserves.
